jobs.occupation: Interest Rate Option Trader – Graduate / Early Career
jobs.description:
Interest rate markets move constantly, and the people who understand them shape how risk is managed for clients across the region. Joining our Derivatives Trading team you will be working directly with experienced traders and building practical expertise in interest-rate options from day one.

What you will be doing

You will be part of a close-knit trading team where analysis, precision, and curiosity matter every day. Working within Derivatives Trading, you will support the pricing and execution of interest rate option transactions, monitor market developments, and collaborate with colleagues across sales, quant, risk, and operations.

More specifically, you will:

· Support pricing and execution of interest rate option transactions under experienced traders

· Monitor interest rate markets, volatility, and economic developments with the team

· Analyse portfolio exposures and help manage risk within agreed limits

· Build and improve tools for pricing and risk monitoring using Python or similar languages

· Collaborate with sales, quant, risk, and operations colleagues to support accurate trade processing

About you

You are a recent graduate or have up to two years of relevant experience in trading, quantitative analysis, asset management or a related field. Previous trading experience is not required. We are interested in your analytical ability, curiosity and willingness to learn.

· Degree in economics with a technical focus, alternatively in mathematics, physics, engineering, or a related quantitative field

· Strong numerical and analytical skills with a structured approach to problem solving

· Genuine interest in fixed income markets and a desire to build a career in trading

· Programming ability in Python or a comparable language, applied to practical problems

· Fluency in English and a Scandinavian language

· Sound judgement, attention to detail, and willingness to ask questions and raise concerns

Familiarity with derivatives, probability, statistics, or numerical methods is an advantage, though no prior trading experience is required. Academic projects, relevant coursework, or internships are all useful ways to demonstrate your analytical interest.

What we offer you

This role offers structured learning through direct collaboration with experienced traders, with responsibility growing as your knowledge deepens. This is a full-time, in-office role with daily access to colleagues who are invested in your progress and development.

Are you ready for the next step?

If this sounds like the right opportunity for you, please get in touch with hiring manager Frederik Dimo-Ungermann at fd i@danskebank.dk with any questions before applying.

We review applications on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

We look forward to hearing from you!

jobs.occupation: Tribe Lead for Cards & Financing Platform tribe
jobs.description:
Our customers deserve banking that fits their lives, not the other way around. As Tribe Lead for the Cards & Financing Platform tribe, you will lead an organisation dedicated to enabling intuitive, embedded, and tailored offerings across cards and financing. This is a rare opportunity to lead at scale within a team that puts customers at the center of every decision.

Overview of Danske Bank

Danske Bank is a leading Nordic financial services group dedicated to strengthening its position in the market by delivering innovative, resilient, and sustainable core capabilities. The mission of the Cards & Financing Platform tribe focuses on enhancing customer experiences across all markets with offerings in mortgages, lending, cards, and branch services, including core financing capabilities supporting Realkredit Danmark, in close collaboration with sister tribes responsible for our customer-facing offerings.

We prioritise sustainability and have refined our organisational structure into focused tribes, each led by experts in their respective fields. The Cards & Financing Platform is a vital component, encompassing approximately 280 colleagues across more than 20 squads primarily located in Denmark, India and Lithuania, all committed to advancing our Forward '28 strategy.

What you will be doing

You will co-lead the Cards & Financing Platform tribe together with the Tribe Leadership Team, which includes an IT Lead, Tribe Coach, and Tribe Architect. All Product Owners and leaders for Business Analysts (Business Chapter Leads) will report to you, making your leadership central to how the tribe collaborates and delivers on the Danske Bank Forward '28 strategy.

More specifically, you will:

• Guide Product Owners and leaders for Business Analysts (Business Chapter Leads) on roadmap priorities and tribe backlog

• Lead strategy, Annual Business Reviews, and Quarterly Business Reviews across the tribe

• Engage senior stakeholders to align on priorities, dependencies, and major decisions

• Engage with large international vendors as part of the tribe's delivery commitments

• Act as HR manager for Product Owners, leaders for Business Analysts (Business Chapter Leads), Business Manager, and Management Coordinator

• Drive tribe performance across delivery, adoption, business outcomes, efficiency, and cost, working closely with commercial stakeholders to realise the value of existing and new solutions

• Drive the development and implementation of GenAI solutions and embed AI-enabled ways of working across the tribe to improve productivity, quality, and customer and business outcomes.

• Drive the tribe’s risk and compliance agenda and, together with the Tribe Leadership Team, advance platform modernisation while maintaining reliable end-to-end services.

About you

• Solid experience leading large, cross-functional technology or product organisations

• Background in cards, financing or daily banking, with a genuine interest in technology

• Ability to translate strategic direction into clear priorities and communicate them accessibly

• Track record of delivering solutions that improve customer experiences

• Skilled at building agile, collaborative cultures where colleagues feel trusted and supported

• Skilled at engaging with senior leaders and managing complex stakeholder relationships

• Open to continuous personal and professional development

What we offer you

You will join the organisation at an important moment, with real responsibility and genuine trust from the start. The role is hybrid, with three to four days per week in the office in Copenhagen to support collaboration and knowledge sharing across a geographically spread tribe. You will have room to develop your own skills while supporting your colleagues to do the same, within a team that values openness, belonging, and shared learning.

Are you ready for the next step?

If you would like to know more about the position, please reach out to Hiring Manager Mark Wraa-Hansen (mark.wraa.hansen@danskebank.dk) head of Personal Banking DK. We review applications on an ongoing basis, so please apply at your earliest convenience or by 23.11.26 at the latest.

We look forward to hearing from you!

jobs.occupation: Senior Consultant – Actuarial Services, Financial Services Advisory
jobs.description:
Are you an actuary with a couple of years of experience looking to broaden your career beyond a traditional actuarial role? Would you like to work across insurance, audit and advisory, helping some of the largest financial institutions solve complex actuarial and business challenges?

Then you might be our new colleague in KPMG’s Financial Services Advisory team in Copenhagen.

The opportunity

We are looking for an ambitious actuary with approximately 2 years of relevant professional experience to strengthen our actuarial capabilities within Financial Services Advisory.

You will join a multidisciplinary team working with insurance companies and other financial institutions. Your assignments will vary from supporting our audit teams on actuarial matters to advising clients directly on actuarial, risk, regulatory and transformation topics.

The role provides a strong opportunity to combine your actuarial expertise with broader business and advisory experience and to develop your career in an environment where you will work closely with experienced colleagues, clients and specialists across KPMG.

What you will be doing

Depending on your experience and interests, your work may include:

• Performing actuarial analyses of insurance liabilities and technical provisions.

• Supporting the audit of insurance companies, including review and challenge of actuarial assumptions, methodologies, models and calculations.

• Working with Solvency II, financial reporting and other regulatory requirements relevant to insurers.

• Reviewing and challenging reserving methodologies, models, assumptions and data.

• Supporting actuarial modelling, validation and quantitative analyses.

• Advising insurance clients on improvements to their actuarial processes, governance, controls and documentation.

• Contributing to projects at the intersection of actuarial science, risk management, regulation, data and technology.

• Working directly with clients and gradually taking responsibility for your own workstreams and deliverables.

• Collaborating with colleagues across KPMG in Denmark and our international network.

The aim is not only for you to apply your actuarial skills, but also to develop into a trusted adviser who understands both the numbers and the business behind them.

Who we are looking for

We expect that you:

• Hold a relevant quantitative degree, ideally within actuarial mathematics, insurance mathematics or a closely related field.

• Have approximately 2 years of relevant experience, for example from an insurance company, consultancy or audit firm.

• Have practical experience with actuarial calculations, models or insurance liabilities.

• Have a strong analytical mindset and enjoy working with complex quantitative topics.

• Are interested in understanding the commercial, regulatory and strategic context surrounding actuarial work.

• Communicate clearly and are comfortable discussing your analyses with both specialists and non-specialists.

• Enjoy working collaboratively and taking responsibility.

• Are fluent in English. Danish or another Nordic language is an advantage.

Experience within life insurance, non-life insurance, pensions, reserving, Solvency II or actuarial audit would be particularly relevant, but we do not expect you to be an expert in all areas.

What we offer

At KPMG, you will have the opportunity to build a career that extends beyond a traditional actuarial role.

You will become part of Financial Services Advisory, where we bring together expertise across insurance, banking, risk, regulation, data, technology and transformation. You will work alongside experienced specialists while being given responsibility early in your career.

We offer:

• A steep learning curve and exposure to different insurance companies and business models.

• The opportunity to combine actuarial expertise with advisory and business skills.

• Direct interaction with clients and senior colleagues.

• Access to KPMG's Danish and international actuarial and financial-services network.

• Opportunities to work on projects beyond traditional actuarial assignments.

• A collaborative and informal environment with strong focus on professional and personal development.

Most importantly, we offer the opportunity to help shape and grow our actuarial capability in Financial Services Advisory.

Why KPMG?

You’ll thrive in a professional environment that emphasizes close team collaboration and cross-functional, international partnerships. You won’t just be a part of a team; You will become integral to a motivated and skilled team of over 60 international professionals driven by progression and professional development.

Our culture is not just a buzzword – It is social, informal, and open, with a flat organizational structure. We value diversity, social well-being, collaboration, and innovative thinking.

Interested?

If you find yourself aligned with this opportunity, then we are excited to get to know you better. Feel free to contact Senior Manager, Teis Dengsøe, tdengsoee@kpmg.com, or Partner Hans Jørgen Andresen, hansjandresen@kpmg.com. We accept applications and interview candidates continuously and will close the position once we have found the right match.

At KPMG, we are committed to developing diverse talents at all levels. We encourage all interested candidates to apply, regardless of age, race, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, religion, or ethnicity.

Please note that we do not accept applications by e-mail to ensure GDPR compliance.

We look forward to welcoming you to KPMG

Danske Bank's Personal Customers business unit is undergoing a significant transformation, and a trusted, scalable data foundation is at the heart of it. As Senior Business Analyst in the Data and Insight cluster, you will sit at the intersection of business, data, and technology, helping commercial teams and system owners unlock real value from data. This is a role where your analytical thinking and collaborative approach will shape better banking experiences for customers across the Nordics.

What you will be doing

You will join the Customer Engagement Individuals Tribe, a diverse group of around 160 colleagues spanning data, technology, design, and business roles, working across the Nordics, Lithuania, and India. Operating within one of our Data Foundation squads, you will work closely with business stakeholders, data owners, and technical teams to ensure that high-quality, trusted data underpins the bank's Forward'28 strategic objectives and be part of driving the Strategic Change helping the bank become more proactive and personalized in our engagement with our customers. Your work will directly support sustainable golden-source data models and reliable data availability for downstream use cases.

In your day-to-day work, you will:

• Translate business logic and requirements into clear, sustainable data specifications

• Collaborate with business stakeholders, system owners, and data owners to prioritise activities

• Ensure thorough documentation and adherence to governance and compliance standards

• Support alignment with regulatory, security, and governance frameworks across the data domain

• Contribute to the bank-wide data agenda in line with the Forward'28 strategy

• Help drive the Strategic Change helping the bank become more proactive and personalized in our engagement with our customers

About you

• 5+ years experience as a Business Analyst, Business and Functional Specialist, or in a similar role

• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with fluency in English

• Analytical mindset with comfort working in complex, changing environments

• Collaborative approach with the ability to bridge business and technical teams

• Bachelor's degree or higher in Business, Engineering, Natural Sciences, or a related field

Familiarity with data analysis tools such as SQL or Excel, and experience with compliance, risk, or financial services data, would be a welcome addition. We value diverse backgrounds and perspectives, and if you meet most of the criteria above, we encourage you to apply.

What we offer you

You will join a collaborative, cross-functional tribe where learning and development are part of everyday work. We operate on a hybrid model, with three to four days per week in the office in Copenhagen or Vilnius, supporting knowledge sharing and team connection. You will have the opportunity to grow your expertise in a domain that sits at the centre of Danske Bank's strategic direction, working alongside colleagues from a wide range of disciplines.

This position can be located both in Denmark and Lithuania (no relocation package included). If the position is located in Lithuania, the salary range will be from 3920 EUR to 5880 EUR gross (based on your competencies relevant for the job) and your job function (position) in the job contract will be Technology Business Solutions.

Have we caught your attention?

Apply now! We process applications continuously, so we encourage you to apply sooner rather than later.

For more information, please contact Hiring Manager Michael Friis Bak on mras@danskebank.dk or Cluster Lead Mikkel Winther mikkelw@danskebank.dk.

Are you passionate about supporting colleagues offshore? Do you want to work in the green offshore wind industry where your skills and expertise will help secure a sustainable future based on renewable energy? Then you might be the Crewing Coordinator we are looking for.

Cadeler is a global partner in offshore wind farm construction and maintenance, and we are part of an industry that is now, more than ever, both relevant and in high demand. As our industry continues to grow, so do we!

**What will you do?

**As our new Crewing Coordinator, you will be in charge of effectively allocating vessel crews and supporting various initiatives for our colleagues offshore. You will support the implementation of policies and procedures while supporting the development of systems in this realm, for both colleagues on and offshore.

**Your Main Tasks Include

**

• Coordinate the scheduling of vessel crews via electronic rotas so personnel are allocated effectively, ensuring manning requirements are met.

• Coordinate the booking of flights, rail tickets, hire cars and hotels for both vessel crew changes (and training courses where necessary).

• Assist the HR/ Head of Marine HR with the induction and initial documentation for offshore crew.

• Support the implementation of recruitment campaigns to source personnel to fill offshore crewing requirements.

• Advise and support project and department manager’s resourcing needs.

• Input data into the HR database and create reports to be analysed by the HR/ Crewing Manager.

• Maintaining all relevant databases including personnel files and offshore crew certification.

• Aiding in internal and external audits when required

• Liaising with internal and external stakeholders in defining crew change requirements and crewing levels.

**To succeed in this role

**Being part of the Cadeler community means you will have a natural interest and care for the environment and our shared mission to speed up the green energy transition. Your environmental considerations and the safety of our people and the planet will be a key priority in your daily work.

We are looking for someone who can stay and work calmly in a high-pressure environment. You have a strong analytical mindset, attention to detail, and take pride in delivering tasks efficiently and to a high standard.

We think you will be a good match if you:

• 4+ years of work experience in an office environment, preferably in the crew coordination space

• Good knowledge of the Microsoft Office Package

• Strong communication skills and proficiency in English and Danish (written and spoken)

• Organised, structured and able to handle multiple priorities

• Prior knowledge of Compas or Omega is an advantage

**Why Cadeler?

**At Cadeler, we believe in building what matters. As part of a global team working in the offshore wind industry, you will contribute to projects that support the energy transition and help shape a more sustainable future.

We believe in trust, collaboration and shared responsibility. We give our people the opportunity to take ownership, develop their skills and grow together, while maintaining high standards in everything we do.

Join us and become part of a team where your contribution matters, your ideas are valued and we set the standard together.

**Come work with us!

**By becoming a Cadeler employee, you will be part of a rapidly growing company with a diverse and energetic team. We offer an exciting position focused on delivering excellence in the face of interesting new challenges, within a positive and rewarding work environment in an international company with great development possibilities.

Cadeler has a global presence, with offices in Copenhagen, Vejle, Norwich, Rotterdam, and Taipei, alongside colleagues working offshore aboard our fleet of Wind Farm Installation Vessels (WFIVs).

Meet some of our colleagues here: https://www.cadeler.com/career

**Apply

**Use the APPLY button to apply for this position. For data protection purposes, applications are only accepted via the link and are assessed continuously until we find the right candidate, so please don’t hesitate to send in your application as soon as possible.

Please be aware, that if hired for the position the title will be Crewing Logistics Coordinator.

If you have any questions regarding the position or practical matters, please contact peopleandculture@cadeler.com.

**ORDERYOYO

****Lead Software Engineer – Payments

**Remote - **_Must be Copenhagen based

_**

• Quarterly team gatherings in one of our global offices

• Competitive salary

**About The Role

**At OrderYOYO, payments sit at the heart of everything we do. Every order placed, every restaurant paid, and every dispute resolved runs through the systems this team owns and operates.

We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer – Payments to help us build a more resilient, scalable, and compliant payments operating model — across online ordering and in-store platforms (POS, Kiosk, and payment terminals).

You'll play a central role in shaping how OrderYOYO handles money — from authorisation and settlement to disputes and merchant invoicing — across a rapidly growing, international restaurant platform.

****Role Mission

****Own and evolve OrderYOYO's payments capabilities — enabling KYC onboarding, deductions, settlement/payout timing, dispute flows, and merchant invoicing — while raising the bar on reliability, security, and engineering quality in one of our most business-critical domains.

****Core Responsibilities

• Design, build, and operate payment-domain services, including gateway integrations and payment intent/authorisation/capture/refund flows, payout orchestration, and reconciliation.

• Implement marketplace capabilities where relevant: onboarding/KYC integration, merchant configuration, settlement instructions, deductions, and invoicing/merchant-statement alignment.

• Build robust “flow-of-funds” primitives — idempotency, ledgers/events, and audit trails — that are fully supportable for finance and compliance.

• Integrate with PSP and partner tooling, with close attention to tri-party / sub-merchant implications where applicable.

• Implement dispute/chargeback and fraud-handling touchpoints across internal workflows and PSP tooling, and collaborate with Ops on runbooks and escalation paths.

• Partner closely with Product, Legal/Compliance, Finance, and Support to convert requirements into safe, testable production behaviour.

• Raise engineering quality in a high-change domain through automated testing, safe rollouts/canaries, observability, and incident-response improvements — and mentor engineers, lead design reviews, and contribute to shared standards and documentation. Payments is too critical to be tribal knowledge.

**Must-Have Requirements

**

• Strong backend engineering background in distributed systems — microservices, async processing, resilient APIs, and eventual consistency.

• Production experience with payment flows (auth/capture/refund, webhooks, reconciliation) and “money correctness” patterns such as idempotency keys, double-entry thinking, and auditability.

• A solid security mindset: PCI compliance, PII protection, secrets management, least privilege, and secure coding practices.

• Comfort working in an Azure-first environment (APIs, queues/eventing, monitoring), with strong CI/CD and automated testing practices.

• Clear, confident communication with non-technical stakeholders in high-stakes scenarios — incidents, financial breaks, and compliance requests.

**Strong-to-Have Experience

**

• Experience with sub-merchant, marketplace, or Payfac-like operating models (KYC, underwriting, settlements, fee deductions).

• Familiarity with dispute tooling, card scheme rules, 3DS/risk rules, or fraud platforms.

**Who We Are

**At OrderYOYO, company culture comes first. We create a positive, inclusive environment where people are trusted to do their best work and take ownership of what they build. Personal development is central to how we work — engineers are encouraged to grow technically, take responsibility, and help shape how our products and platforms evolve.

We help restaurants succeed online by providing branded websites, mobile apps, and tailored marketing solutions, giving them full control of their business. By removing high commission fees charged by third-party platforms, we empower restaurants to grow sustainably.

Through our partnership with AppSmart, the market leader in POS and in-store systems, we've become the largest restaurant-focused platform in Europe.

**What We Offer

**

• A salary of DKK66,000/ month

• A role based in Copenhagen.

• High ownership and autonomy over the services you build.

• The opportunity to work on revenue-critical production systems.

• A strong focus on security, reliability, and engineering best practices.

• A collaborative, international engineering team.

• Real emphasis on learning, mentoring, and personal development.

Project Manager - IT, Automation & Robotics

Location: Kalundborg, Denmark

Department: API Expansions - Pre-G3 Projects & Project Execution

Are you passionate about delivering complex projects and bringing innovative technologies into pharmaceutical manufacturing?

Do you enjoy collaborating across technical disciplines, turning challenges into opportunities and helping shape the future of production facilities?

We are looking for a Project Manager to join our IT, Automation & Robotics team within API Expansions at Novo.

This is an exciting opportunity to contribute to significant capital investment projects, working with experienced specialists and engineering partners to support the development and modernisation of our manufacturing facilities.

If you have project management experience, a good understanding of industrial IT and automation, and the ambition to develop your career within a growing project organisation, we would love to hear from you.

The position

As our new Project Manager, you will be responsible for leading IT, Automation and Robotics workstreams within largescale capital  investment projects across API Expansions.

You will primarily work in the early phases of projects, helping define scope, establish requirements, develop reliable plans and forecasts, and ensure that technical uncertainties are identified and addressed before projects progress into execution.

Working closely with Solution Architects, engineering partners and colleagues across the organisation, you will help translate operational and technical requirements into structured project deliverables.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• Leading and coordinating IT, Automation and Robotics project activities within major capital investment programmes.

• Developing project scope, schedules, cost estimates, forecasts and delivery plans in accordance with Novo's global standards.

• Collaborating with Solution Architects and technical specialists to understand proposed solutions, dependencies and potential project risks.

• Working closely with Process, Engineering, Global IT, Quality and other stakeholders to align requirements and project objectives.

• Coordinating external engineering partners, suppliers and system integrators to support successful project delivery.

• Identifying technical uncertainties and opportunities early, helping establish robust solutions before projects move into detailed design and execution.

• Monitoring project progress, budgets, risks and deliverables, ensuring appropriate governance and reporting.

• Supporting the development and continuous improvement of project management processes, standards and ways of working within the department.

• You will typically be assigned to one major project, although you may occasionally support more than one project depending on their scope and complexity.

The position offers exposure to a diverse portfolio of projects, including purification, fermentation, recovery, logistics and utility facilities, providing opportunities to develop your experience across different manufacturing processes and technologies.

Qualifications

To succeed in this role, we imagine that you bring a combination of project management experience, technical understanding and strong interpersonal skills.

We are looking for someone who has:

• A relevant educational background in Engineering, Automation, IT, Project Management or a related technical discipline.

• At least three years of project management experience, preferably within industrial IT, automation, manufacturing or a related technical environment.

• A practical understanding of industrial IT/OT systems and automation technologies, with the ability to engage effectively with technical specialists.

• Experience in project planning, scheduling, cost estimation, forecasting, risk management or coordinating project deliverables.

• Experience working with multidisciplinary teams and influencing stakeholders without direct line management responsibility.

• Strong communication, collaboration and organisational skills.

• Professional proficiency in English.

• Experience within pharmaceutical manufacturing or another regulated industry would be advantageous. However, we also welcome relevant experience from engineering consultancies, technology suppliers, system integrators and other highly automated manufacturing industries.

• Familiarity with technologies such as DCS, MES, process historians, DeltaV or ABB 800xA would be beneficial, although you are not expected to be a technical specialist across every platform.

• Danish language skills would be an advantage but are not essential.

• As a person, you are structured, curious and proactive. You enjoy working with others, taking ownership of your responsibilities and finding solutions to complex challenges.

• You are comfortable asking questions, challenging existing approaches constructively and learning from experienced colleagues.

Above all, you bring a collaborative mindset, a willingness to develop and the ambition to make a meaningful contribution to both project outcomes and the continued development of the team.

About the department

You will join the Pre-G3 Projects & Project Execution department within API Expansions, supporting the IT, Automation and Robotics elements of major capital investment projects.

Our department brings together Project Managers, Project Directors and Solution Architects who collaborate across disciplines to support the development of new facilities and the modernisation of existing manufacturing operations.

A central part of our approach is to identify and resolve technical uncertainties early in the project lifecycle, enabling stronger project definition, more reliable forecasts and smoother execution.

We work closely with colleagues across Novo, as well as external engineering partners and technology suppliers, supporting projects in Denmark and internationally.

You will join a collaborative environment where knowledge sharing, continuous improvement and professional development are encouraged.

You will receive support from your manager and experienced colleagues as you develop your knowledge of our project standards, technologies and ways of working, with the opportunity to take increasing ownership of complex projects.

The position is based in Kalundborg, with an expectation of approximately four days per week on site. The remaining day may be worked flexibly, including from another Novo location, subject to business needs.

Why Novo

At Novo, we are driving change to defeat serious chronic diseases.

For more than a century, we have worked to improve the lives of people living with serious chronic conditions. Our success is built on scientific innovation, a commitment to quality and the dedication of our colleagues around the world.

Joining Novo means becoming part of an organisation where your work contributes to something bigger.

Within API Expansions, you will have the opportunity to help develop and modernise manufacturing facilities that support the delivery of life changing medicines to patients around the world.

Working at Novo

Every day, we seek solutions that make a lasting difference for patients.

We recognise that meaningful progress requires collaboration, curiosity and the willingness to challenge conventional thinking.

Your impact begins here

As Product Development Engineer Specialist, you will shape how primary packaging and device engineering come together to create reliable products for people who depend on them. Using design controls, risk management and systems thinking, you will guide technical decisions on new products and on products already on the market. This is your chance to build shared ways of working that strengthen every decision and support people living with serious chronic diseases.

What you’ll bring

This role needs deep expertise in regulated product development and the credibility to align colleagues around shared technical decisions. You will bring:

• A degree in engineering or science.

• Fluent English, written and spoken.

• Extensive experience in medical device or other regulated product development, with direct experience of injection devices and/or pre-filled syringes.

• Practical command of the design-control lifecycle: requirements, design inputs and outputs, traceability, verification and validation, design reviews, transfer and design changes.

• Hands-on product risk management experience across development, manufacturing, transportation and use.

• The ability to make risk-based technical trade-offs when design, quality, patient, manufacturing and product considerations need to be balanced.

• Natural technical leadership: you build trust, facilitate open discussion and guide colleagues from different disciplines towards well-founded decisions.

Useful, but not essential:

• Formal systems engineering experience or training, and a track record of structuring complex work across interfaces and dependencies.

• Deep primary packaging knowledge. If you come from device development, curiosity and the ability to learn this area are what count.

• Experience working with regulatory authorities or contributing to technical sections of regulatory submissions.

What you’ll do

You will be the technical link between primary packaging and device engineering, covering both new product development and lifecycle management of marketed products.

• Connect primary packaging and device perspectives in technical decisions, so colleagues understand each other’s needs, constraints and interfaces.

• Drive design controls and risk management across development and post-launch changes, keeping requirements, traceability and design rationale complete and clear.

• Guide verification and validation strategy: decide what needs to be tested and why, working with the test engineers who carry out the testing.

• Take a systems view of the whole product, balancing technical, quality, patient and manufacturing considerations when making trade-offs.

• Act as a technical role model who builds sustainable ways of working across teams, beyond formal processes and handovers.

• Share knowledge and coach colleagues, from recent graduates to engineers with 25+ years at Novo.

Who you’ll work with

You will join Drug Delivery Innovation as an additional specialist within the Pre-filled Syringe Team. Day to day, you will work across the primary packaging and device teams, and with the wider area covering development projects with pre-filled syringes and the devices built around them.

Your colleagues are mostly engineers and scientists, about half Danish and half international, with experience from new graduate to 25+ years. You will also collaborate with Regulatory Affairs, Quality Assurance, Medical & Science and Product Supply, and with suppliers, as the work requires.

In Global Manufacturing & Supply, colleagues work across the value chain from drug and device development to marketed Novo products. This role sits in that chain and helps colleagues win together.

What you can expect here

You will be trusted to own your area, make your voice heard and perform at your best. You will build new skills by working across engineering disciplines and the product lifecycle, and through relevant learning offerings, conferences and training. You will be part of a team that expects high standards, honest feedback and clear decisions.

jobs.occupation: Senior Cell Bank Scientist, CMC Drug Development
jobs.description:
Your impact begins here

Ready to bring together microbial science, GMP manufacturing and project responsibility in a senior role where your work directly supports the development of future medicines? Join our Microbial Cell Bank team, where every drug substance begins - we manufacture and maintain the cell banks that are the starting point for drug substance production all over the world. Working cross-functionally across projects, you will combine your scientific expertise with GMP responsibility and help drive continuous improvement of our Cell Bank operation. Ready to take the lead where every medicine begins? Apply today!

**What you’ll do

**As a Senior Scientist in the Microbial Cell Bank, you will take a leading professional role in activities related to the production and lifecycle management of our cell banks. You will take ownership of complex tasks and projects, working closely with scientists, laboratory technicians, QA, QC and project teams. With your experience, you will help navigate cross-functional processes, identify solutions and contribute to developing both our processes and ways of working. Depending on your experience and interests, the role provides an opportunity to build deeper expertise and potentially develop towards a specialist position.

Your main responsibilities will include:

• Planning and supporting GMP manufacture of microbial Master Cell Banks (MCBs) and Working Cell Banks (WCBs).

• Taking project responsibility for cell bank projects from incoming Initial Cell Clone (ICC) through production, characterisation, release and lifecycle activities.

• Preparing and maintaining specifications, production documentation and other GMP documentation.

• Coordinating activities and solving issues across QA, QC, project teams and other key stakeholders.

• Handling deviations and change requests and driving systematic problem solving.

• Supporting regulatory activities, audits, inspections and responses to Health Authority questions.

• Driving continuous improvements to cell bank processes and ways of working.

• Contributing to the continued digitalisation of our Cell Bank operation and exploring how new technologies, including AI, can support smarter and more efficient ways of working.

What you’ll bring

To succeed in this role, we imagine that you hold a relevant master’s degree within biotechnology, microbiology, biochemistry or a related scientific field. You also have:

• a solid background from the pharmaceutical industry and a strong understanding of GMP.

• hands-on skills in microbial cultivation and knowledge of microbiology, molecular biology, cellular biology and analytical science.

• a proven ability to navigate a complex organisation and work across functions.

• a strong quality mindset combined with an analytical and pragmatic approach to problem solving.

• an interest in digitalisation and new technology. Experience with AI is an advantage, but curiosity and motivation to explore how AI can improve our work are equally important.

On a personal level, you are collaborative, curious and motivated by taking professional and independent ownership of activities and projects involving multiple stakeholders. You enjoy sharing your knowledge and contributing to the development of others while continuously strengthening your own expertise. You communicate effectively across functions and organisational levels and are comfortable challenging existing ways of working when you see opportunities to improve.

Who you’ll work with

CMC Development turns promising molecules into approved products in close collaboration with colleagues across Research & Development and Global Manufacturing & Supply.

Cell Banks are at the starting point of drug substance production and play an important role in bringing new medicines through CMC Drug Development. We are a team of approximately 16 scientists and laboratory technicians working with microbial cell banks in Bagsværd and mammalian cell banks in Hillerød, with an ambition to collaborate closely and share knowledge across the two locations.

We have a strong focus on quality, collaboration and delivering for our projects. At the same time, we are ambitious about developing the Cell Bank area and continuously improving our processes, facilities and digital ways of working. We value an open and collaborative environment where we help each other, share knowledge and believe that having fun at work is an important part of being a strong team.

What you can expect here

You will work in an international environment where your expertise is valued, and your contribution can shape decisions across markets. You will be supported to perform at your best and trusted to take ownership. You will be encouraged to make your voice heard, learn from colleagues and contribute to work that helps create progress for people living with serious chronic diseases. We foster a collaborative culture where we care for one another, value initiative, and empower you to drive projects forward while growing professionally.

**What we offer

**Salary: The annual base salary for this role ranges from DKK 651,000 to DKK 956,900, depending on the level of the position. Placement within the range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

Incentives and benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives and other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area, and relevant market benchmarks. Learn more about our Reward Philosophy here.

Start now

Please apply by 22 November 2026.

**

Due to the short deadline, please apply as soon as possible. We review CVs and invite candidates to interview on an ongoing basis.**

If you have any questions about the position, please feel free to contact Associate Director Jesper Roland Jørgensen at +45 30797885.

While not mandatory, we strongly encourage you to submit a cover letter explaining why you are the ideal candidate to join us in the Cell Bank team. Please do not include a photo in your CV, as this supports a fair and efficient recruitment process.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

jobs.description:
Are you motivated by the opportunity to deepen your leadership, commercial and advisory impact while contributing to sustainable growth in the operational transformation area? As Associate Partner and Competence Team Lead for Valcon’s Operational Transformation team, you will play a key role in developing our people, strengthening client partnerships and evolving our capabilities. And you will be instrumental in growing the area considerably in the future matching Valcon’s growth ambitions.

Role and profile

The job is located at the intersection between client delivery, team leadership, commercial work and service offering development.

You will lead a team of approximately 12 consultants and help shape the continued development of our Operational Transformation offerings, focused on Process Redesign and Process Automation, including agentic automation. You are expected to support the further integration of AI, data and technological capabilities into the services based on a clear understanding of our clients’ business needs and strategic ambitions. The ideal candidate brings deep experience and insight from both operations’ excellence and business process redesign as well as technology-driven business change and automation.

You will also act as a trusted advisor to clients, and contribute to Valcon’s growth by being commercial active, building trusted client relationships and lead projects that deliver sustainable results.

To thrive in this role, you have demonstrated experience in these four competence areas:

• Team leadership: Guide, inspire and develop a talented team of consultants, fostering an inclusive environment where people can thrive, collaborate effectively and deliver meaningful results together

• Commercial growth: Strengthen Valcon’s position as a trusted advisor by building long-term client partnerships and creating sustainable growth opportunities together with clients

• Client engagement: Manage and deliver complex projects with high-quality standards from initial mobilization to final delivery and further expansions

• Service development leadership: Develop internal capabilities and strengthen methodologies with AI, data, and technology as key enablers of business transformation

The role offers a high degree of autonomy and responsibility. The ability to balance time between all four areas is key, as they are equally important for success in this role.

In addition, you should embody these skills:

• People skills: Build and nurture existing relationships and teams through empathy, engagement and effective communication with clear direction

• Business and digital acumen: Think analytically and strategically with a pragmatic approach to execution. View AI, data and digital technology as integral elements of modern business development

• Subject-matter-expertise: Business process redesign, improvement and automation

• Education: Speak and write English fluently and professionally, with Danish being a plus. Completed relevant higher education or equivalent professional experience. Further education is a plus

Organisation and reporting

You will be the direct people manager of the Operational Transformation team of consultants (excluding Associate Partners and Partners) or managing their people managers. The role reports to a Partner from either one of our Commercial Sectors or our Head of Consulting.

Location and travel

The role is based at Valcon’s offices in central Copenhagen or Århus, Denmark. You can expect travel in connection with client meetings and project work, primarily within the Nordic region.

About Valcon

We are a European powerhouse in AI and data-driven business transformation, bringing this to life by integrating management consulting with data and digital technology capabilities.

We ensure companies are in their best possible shape – fit for the future. We spot opportunities and help bring them to life. We are thorough, fast and collaborative in everything we do. From the boardroom to the shop floor. From strategy to operations.

We are a no-nonsense consultancy with curious individuals who are driven by creating value together with clients. We have an informal culture and a flat hierarchy with offices in Denmark, Sweden, the Netherlands, the UK, Germany, Croatia and Serbia.

Career opportunities

Valcon is in a significant growth phase supported by acquisitions and capital investment from Rivean Capital and Waterland Private Equity. This supports our ambitious expansion plans – both geographically and in terms of capabilities – with a particular focus on the Nordics and the DACH (German-speaking) region. Therefore, you will have a unique opportunity to help shape the company’s development and gain strategic influence over its future direction.

The role provides internal career development opportunities toward broader leadership roles within the capability or across the broader organisation. With Valcon’s international footprint and focus on complex transformation projects in the business and technological space, you will gain access to:

• A broad network of colleagues and clients across Europe

• Strategically significant and high-complexity projects

• Opportunities to work with cutting-edge technology, including AI, data and digital technologies

Application

If this role sounds like a good match, we warmly encourage you to apply and share how your experience, strengths and perspective could contribute to the team. Deadline for applications is Monday December 7, but we do review applications on an ongoing basis.

Your impact begins here

Turn financial data into insights and support for decisions that help build future manufacturing capacity for patients worldwide. As Finance Partner in Drug Product Manufacturing (DPM) Expansions, you will be part of strengthening cost transparency and financial reporting, combined with improving forecasts and helping secure right resource planning across a multi-billion DKK investment portfolio. Your insights will support across the Global Project Management Office (GPMO) and selected expansion sites. You will combine independent ownership with close collaboration in an experienced finance team. Key is that you are ready for a step learning curve and take ownership in your work and bring high energy and motivation to make a difference within delivering sound financial management.

What you'll bring

You can translate complex financial information into clear business insights and recommendations and build trusted relationships with stakeholders from expansion sites to the finance community. For this role, the essentials are:

• A master’s degree in finance, accounting, economics, business administration or a related discipline.

• Relevant experience in financial planning and analysis, business finance, controlling or business partnering, including independent delivery of reporting and analysis.

• Strong understanding of financial reporting, budgeting and forecasting, with close attention to data quality.

• Clear communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to explain findings simply and build a compelling financial story.

• Fluency in written and spoken English, together with a structured approach to deadlines and commitments.

• Useful, but not essential: experience with financial planning systems and improving reporting through digital tools.

What you'll do

• Lead and coordinate the month-end closing process across capital expenditure, operating expenditure and workforce planning, bringing inputs together into a high-quality monthly management report.

• Consolidate and analyse operating expenditure (OPEX) and manning data for monthly reporting, budgets and forecasts, explaining deviations and identifying risks early.

• Partner with GPMO budget owners to assess cost and manning, as well as support resource prioritisation within agreed budgets.

• Work with selected site project finance teams to improve collaboration and insights even further to secure sharpen OPEX financial execution and forecast, as well as strong financial follow-through and follow up on assumptions, deviations and agreed actions.

• Challenge assumptions and resolve complex financial issues within your scope, while seeking input from senior colleagues when it adds value.

• Simplify reporting and finance processes through common standards, efficient workflows and effective use of digital tools and AI adoption.

Who you'll work with

You will join the Finance & Procurement team within the GPMO for DPM Expansions. The team brings together finance management, financial compliance, procurement, contract management and digital solutions. Your closest partners will include experienced finance colleagues and corporate finance functions, GPMO budget owners, site project finance teams and digital colleagues across the expansion portfolio.

DPM Expansions delivers major capital investment projects that establish manufacturing capacity for current and future demand, working with standardised equipment and processes, advanced technology and flexible facility designs, with a strong focus on safety, cost, time and good manufacturing practice compliance. You will contribute financial clarity that helps these teams make timely, well-informed choices.

What you can expect here

You will have independent ownership of defined processes and stakeholder relationships, while having close internal collaborations and sparring with finance and investment colleagues. The role offers broad exposure to a global major investment portfolio and the opportunity to strengthen your business partnering, financial reporting and process-improvement skills. You can expect a collaborative environment where asking questions, constructively challenging assumptions and sharing knowledge are valued.

Salary: For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 570,200 to 838,100 DKK, corresponding to the level of the position. The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge and relevant experience.

Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area and relevant market benchmarks. Learn more about our Reward Philosophy here.

Start now

Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

For questions, please reach out to Sr. Finance Partner - Anders Hvidt, +45 3444 4375
